dayToDay: Pull and clean NPS, CSAT, and effort score data from Medallia, Qualtrics, or Google Forms into a consolidated Power BI dashboard
Conduct thematic analysis of 500-1000 verbatim customer comments per month, categorizing feedback into product, service, and process themes
Present CX findings to product and operations teams in a monthly insight report, recommending 2-3 specific actions per cycle
Design and run A/B tests on customer survey question wording to improve response rates and data quality
humanEdge: Identifies the insight behind the data point -- why customers are saying something, not just what -- through pattern recognition and contextual judgment
Translates analytical findings into language that resonates with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
skills: Power BI or Google Looker Studio

destinations.title: Head of Customer Experience
destinations.description: A Head of CX owns the entire customer experience strategy across all touchpoints -- digital, human, and AI-mediated. For someone who has operated in service and understands the full customer journey, this is the path to building and leading a function.
dayToDay: Set the CX strategy and OKRs for the year in collaboration with the CEO, defining which customer moments matter most and what "great" looks like in each
Lead a team of 10-50 service, QA, and operations staff through direct reports, running weekly leadership team meetings
Own the CX technology stack -- selecting, implementing, and retiring tools including CRM, ticketing, survey, and AI platforms

Present service design recommendations in a final delivery report with prioritized implementation roadmap and success metrics
humanEdge: Empathizes with customers in a way that goes beyond personas and journey maps -- drawing on firsthand experience of what it feels like to be on the receiving end of poor service
